title: Fishy Folk
description: An Origins mod data pack with merling spinoff origins
body:
# Fishy Folk

> Issue tracking in the Origins Discord Server

This pack adds 5 Origins, all of them a different spin on the boring old merling. I know this might be the 234th merling datapack but it is what it is. :P

* Coral Merling
* Octopus Merling
* Phrouretes Merling (Guardian Merling)
* Pufferfish Merling
* Shark Merling

The pack also has an MIT license, this README file, an icon and some misc debug functions.

![A Minecraft Merling with a shark tail lying on a yellow coral reef](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/9bUHNrxp/images/38d744d628c164232f479927b103eecb32342d99.png)

## Coral Merling 🟠🟠

Species of carnivorous merling with brightly coloured scales, usually lurk in shallow, warm coral reefs.

### Gills

You can breathe underwater, but not on land.

### Aqua Affinity

You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.

### Like Water

When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.

### Carnivore

Your diet is restricted to meat, you can't eat vegetables.

### Wet Eyes [Toggle with `Primary Power`]

Your eyes can see under water, but only in shallow waters, as the pressure damages your eyes.

### Svelte Body [Pehkui scale multiplier 0.8]

You have a gracefully slim and agile body, but you have much less health.

### Swift Swimmer

Your sleek tail can propel you at high speeds through the water.

### Splash! [Active ability, use with `Secondary Power`]

You can boost yourself to get away from enemies faster.

### Fish In a Bucket [Active ability, use with `Right Button`]

You can hop onto other people's head.

### Fish Stix

Raw fish saturates you more than it would others.

### Pointy Teeth

Your pointy teeth help you hunt fish faster.

### Flip Flop

You don't have legs and are wet all the time so you're slippery and can't move fast outside of water.

## Octopus Merling 🔴🔴🔴

Species of eight legged merling, they are highly agile and can produce ink.

### Aqua Affinity

You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.

### Like Water

When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.

### Wet Eyes [Toggle with `Primary Power`]

Your vision underwater is perfect.

### Dual Breather

You can stay on land a lot longer than other sea creatures.

### Ink Blast [You need to have water in your lungs to produce ink!]

You can blast ink to boost yourself in water.

### Creature of Many Arms [You reach further, can step up 1 block and swim faster!]

You have 8 limbs growing from your waist that aid in grabbing, swimming and walking, but it makes it impossible to use shields or wear pants and boots.

### Squishy [Pehkui scale multiplier: 0.6]

Due to having no bones, you are squishy and take less fall damage, but you have less health and are smaller.

## Phrouretes Merling 🟠🟠

An ancient species of merling, phrouretai protect the elders of their hives in the fallen cities of the sea. *(basically Guardian merling with a classy name)*

### Gills

You can breathe underwater, but not on land.

### Wet Eyes [Toggle with `Primary Power`]

Your vision underwater is perfect.

### Aqua Affinity

You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.

### Like Water

When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.

### Cold Blood

You don't handle heat well, thus you take extra fire damage.

### Kinship [original power by thearchitects6199. thank you <3]

Your fellow phrouretai don't attack you.

### Slowed Escape [Active ability, use with `Secondary Power`]

You can give mining fatigue on command to those around you.

### Prickly

Out of your skin protrude many sharp prismarine spikes.

### Fins

Since you have a strong tailfin from the waist down, you can swim well.

### Flip Flop

You don't have legs and are wet all the time so you're slippery and can't move fast outside of water.

## Pufferfish Merling 🔴🔴🔴

Species of merling, covered in spikes with deadly poison, inflates when attacked.

### Gills

You can breathe underwater, but not on land.

### Wet Eyes [Toggle with `Primary Power`]

Your vision underwater is perfect.

### Aqua Affinity

You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.

### Like Water

When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.

### Vegetarian

You can't digest any meat.

### Fins

Since you are a pufferfish from the waist down, you can swim well.

### Small Boi

You don't have much health.

### Puffy Boi [Pehkui scale multiplyer: 0.6]

You are a little spiky ball of fish, so cute!

### Toadies' Touch [Has a cooldown and needs hunger to refill poison levels.]

You evolved little toxic spikes all over you body, so you you poison you foes.

### No Friendly Fire

Since your body produces poison, you are immune to toxins.

### Flip Flop

You don't have legs and are wet all the time so you're slippery and can't move fast outside of water.

## Shark Merling 🔴🔴🔴

Species of merling, adapted to a hunter's lifestyle, can smell blood from miles away. *(sharks are so huggable looking🦈)*

### Gills

You can breathe underwater, but not on land.

### Wet Eyes [Toggle with `Primary Power`]

Your vision underwater is perfect.

### Aqua Affinity

You may break blocks underwater as others do on land.

### Like Water

When underwater, you do not sink to the ground unless you want to.

### Carnivore

Your diet is restricted to meat, you can't eat vegetables.

### Sturdy

You are a big creature thus you have more health.

### Teeth and Claws

Your sharp teeth and sharp claws aid in hunting.

### Fins

Since you are a shark from the waist down, you can swim faster than others.

### Smell [Nearby damaged and undead mobs get a highlight.]

You have a good nose, so you can smell blood from miles away.

### Great White [Pehkui scale multiplyer: 1.6]

You have a big body, almost 3 blocks long!

### Flip Flop

You don't have legs and are wet all the time so you're slippery and can't move fast outside of water.
